run_hydra_app: run a Hydra app that prints the resolved configuration as YAML to stdout
create_hydra_main_app: create a minimal Hydra app using @hydra.main that prints the config as YAML
test_hydra_config_print: test the Hydra app my_app to verify it prints the resolved config as YAML
refactor_hydra_app: refactor the Hydra my_app function to add custom logic beyond printing the config
summarize_hydra_main_decorator: summarize how the @hydra.main decorator sets up configuration management and passes DictConfig to my_app
